rules: All holder dictionaries and claim-only observations below are copied exactly from accepted C01 research (saudi-arabia.json). Grouping them under an existing person ID does not promote dates, prove a tenure or extend an office.

Point observations are never expanded to full terms. No start or end is inferred from a successor, pledge, death announcement, delegation or order; those remain claims. The death announcements and the 1 January 1996 delegation decree are used only as exclusive appearance boundaries.

Requested windows are appearance intervals from the CLAUDE-C06-SAUDIARABIA-01 handoff with exclusive ends. Where a bound comes from office_links, leaders_1990.json or the handoff rather than accepted research, the portrait entry says so.
The batch has two people and four portrait windows; each window is one render job, keyed person_id:start-year in 'portraits'.
Real history stops at 2026-09-07; every window in this batch lies before it.

Image dates describe the source photograph, never the appearance window. Every age gap and every artistic extension (standing body, hands, robe hems, shoes, omitted cane) is declared in the prompt and here.

Likeness references are dated photographs of the exact person whose licence string, as stated by Commons extmetadata, matches FREE_LICENSES exactly (all four are 'Public domain' US federal works). Saudi Press Agency and Royal Court photographs, GODL-India files and ported licences were rejected. Original bytes and metadata stay outside Git; the repository copy is byte-identical. Nothing was cropped, edited or labelled; crops happen at registration.

Claude generates, edits and labels no image. Codex renders with its built-in image tool from the exact prompt files and input order in render-request-batch-01.md and returns the unchanged outputs; Claude then performs and records the identity, likeness, era and visual review. No review flag is true yet.
Each review batch contains at most ten people.
HTTP response header captures are never saved, copied, cited, hashed or committed; HTTP 429 response bodies were deleted.

Prompt sha256 values are over the LF bytes committed to Git (equal to `git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum`). No .gitattributes rule covers these files yet, so a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true writes CRLF bytes; that hash is recorded beside each pin.
Birth dates and ages used in age notes are general biographical knowledge, not accepted C01 research; the registry gives no birth date for either person.

likeness_references.people_in_frame: Full-length colour photograph. Abdullah is the tall man at centre right in a plain white ghutra with a double black agal, thin gold-toned metal-rimmed glasses, a black moustache and a separate black chin beard, a white thobe and a very dark brown bisht with gold edging. Also in frame: a US official in glasses and a suit behind Cohen, a Saudi officer in a green beret, a uniformed officer at the left edge, and several Saudi men in red-and-white checked headcloths, including a bespectacled, goateed man at the far right. By general biographical knowledge (born about 1924; not C01 research or registry data) he is about 74 in the photograph and about 71 to 81 across the window. The prompt keeps him about 75, as photographed, with no large age adjustment. If Codex moves the start to 1990-01-01, the photograph is about 8.8 years after the start (ages 65 to 81) and the prompt needs a v2.

access_limits: Wikimedia Commons returned HTTP 429 several times during preparation (parallel agents on one IP). Requests were made one at a time with back-offs; six Fahd full-text searches were not retried. Nothing was bypassed.
The Fahd 1991 verifier's Wayback thumbnail requests got HTTP 429 five times in one loop before it backed off; those bodies were deleted.

The assembler made four Wayback requests on 2026-10-02: a CDX digest-filter query that returned an empty 200 (deleted), the CDX URL query, the archived P38849-17 file and the archived gallery page. The gallery request first got HTTP 429; its body was deleted and it succeeded once after a 90-second back-off.
The defense.gov and dodmedia.osd.mil source pages named on the DoD files were not fetched.
source_ledger.not_listed: No HTTP response header captures were saved. Search scratch (refs/fahd_bin_abdulaziz_al_saud/search/, the candidates/ category listings other than those cited, planner/ search JSON) and preparers' downscaled view copies in session scratchpads are not ledgered; rejected candidates retained as evidence are cited with their sha256 where relevant.
